```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById("outreach");
  if (!root) return;
  var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".ol-all .ol-card"));

  /* hero counters (count up once) */
  root.querySelectorAll("[data-stat]").forEach(function (el) {
    var target = cards.filter(function (c) { return c.dataset.type === el.dataset.stat; }).length;
    var reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    if (reduce) { el.textContent = target; return; }
    var n = 0, step = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(target / 20));
    var t = setInterval(function () { n = Math.min(target, n + step); el.textContent = n; if (n >= target) clearInterval(t); }, 45);
  });

  /* filters: one type chip + one language chip + free-text search */
  var state = { type: "", lang: "", q: "" };
  var empty = root.querySelector(".ol-empty");
  var input = root.querySelector(".ol-search input");
  function apply() {
    var shown = 0;
    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      var ok = (!state.type || c.dataset.type === state.type) &&
               (!state.lang || (" " + c.dataset.lang + " ").indexOf(" " + state.lang + " ") !== -1) &&
               (!state.q || c.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(state.q) !== -1);
      c.hidden = !ok;
      if (ok) shown++;
    });
    if (empty) empty.hidden = shown > 0;
  }
  root.querySelectorAll(".ol-chips").forEach(function (group) {
    group.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var chip = e.target.closest(".ol-chip");
      if (!chip) return;
      group.querySelectorAll(".ol-chip").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove("is-active"); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false"); });
      chip.classList.add("is-active"); chip.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
      state[group.dataset.group] = chip.dataset.value;
      apply();
    });
  });
  if (input) input.addEventListener("input", function () { state.q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase(); apply(); });
  var reset = root.querySelector(".ol-reset");
  if (reset) reset.addEventListener("click", function () {
    state = { type: "", lang: "", q: "" };
    if (input) input.value = "";
    root.querySelectorAll(".ol-chips").forEach(function (g) {
      g.querySelectorAll(".ol-chip").forEach(function (b, i) { b.classList.toggle("is-active", i === 0); });
    });
    apply();
  });

  /* cards fade up as they scroll into view */
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
    root.classList.add("ol-anim");
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.remove("ol-pending"); io.unobserve(en.target); }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: "0px 0px -40px 0px" });
    root.querySelectorAll(".ol-card").forEach(function (c, i) {
      c.classList.add("ol-pending");
      c.style.transitionDelay = (i % 3) * 70 + "ms";
      io.observe(c);
    });
  }
})();
</script>
```
